summary: End-to-end verification of (1) register/login regression fix returning JSON not HTML, (2) password reset backend + UI flow, (3) Google sign-in button placement on Login/Register screens (removed from Welcome), and (4) Stripe /payments/config regression. 8/8 pytest backend tests pass. UI flow verified: Welcome has no Google button; Login has Google + Forgot password link; Register has Google + 'or sign up with email' divider + hint text; Forgot->Reset navigation pre-fills the 6-digit code in URL and input; submitting new password logs the user in and old password is rejected by /api/auth/login (401) while new password works (200).

issues: React-Native-Web is NOT emitting most testID props as data-testid on the DOM. Only [data-testid=google-signin-btn-login] and [data-testid=forgot-password-link] on the login screen are actually present. The following advertised testIDs are missing from the rendered DOM: google-signup-btn (register), forgot-submit-btn (forgot-password), reset-submit-btn (reset-password). Functionality works, but automated tests must fall back to text/placeholder selectors.

Multiple hidden shadow <input> elements are present in the DOM (RN-Web autofill helpers). Playwright's default first-visible selector matches the hidden one — E2E tests need .last or offsetParent filtering. Consider using expo-router's <Head> or a native <input> directly to avoid hidden duplicates.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Make testID prop-forwarding consistent for the DS Button/Input on web so data-testid attributes advertised in code actually appear in the DOM (currently only Button on login screen exposes them). Verify google-signup-btn / forgot-submit-btn / reset-submit-btn render as data-testid on web-build.

OPTIONAL: The hidden autofill shadow inputs on RN-Web make E2E selectors brittle — pin the visible input with placeholder-based locators or add explicit data-testid on the <TextInput> underlying element.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.ts /auth/forgot-password correctly returns 200 with {ok:true} for unknown emails (no info leak) and returns resetCode inline only when NODE_ENV != 'production' — good.
auth.ts /auth/reset-password correctly invalidates the old passwordHash and returns fresh token; also sets emailVerified=true (reasonable since possession of the emailed code proves ownership).
Password reset code TTL is 30 min; make sure passwordResetExpiresAt is a timestamp-with-timezone column in Drizzle schema so the Date.getTime() comparison remains correct across pod restarts.
Nice: /auth/login now handles nullable passwordHash defensively (`!user.passwordHash || !verifyPassword(...)` → 401), which supports Google-only accounts without leaking their existence.

success_rate.frontend: 100% functional (welcome/login/register/forgot/reset all verified visually + via API)
